definitions.explanation: The aquatic larval stage of a frog or toad, with a round body and tail but no legs.
A playful colloquial term for the round-headed notes on a musical staff, which resemble tadpoles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おたまじゃくし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are lots of tadpoles in the pond.

examples.japanese: おたまじゃくし⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}え→生える：02392_haeru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Legs are starting to grow on the tadpoles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧おたまじゃくし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえ→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: When spring came, the children went to the rice paddies to catch tadpoles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おたまじゃくし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I can't read the notes on the sheet music.

examples.japanese: ⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「おたまじゃくし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{音符|おんぷ}→音符：06988_onpu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気付|きづ}いた→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧。
examples.english: When my grandchild asked me to "write a tadpole," I realized they meant a musical note.

examples.japanese: ⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧っぽく「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧おたまじゃくし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧て⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: The piano teacher jokingly asked, "What note is this little tadpole?"

notes:
Literally "little お{玉|たま} (ladle) + じゃくし (ladle/dipper)." The shape of a tadpole resembles a small ladle. The kanji form {御玉杓子|おたまじゃくし} exists but the kana form is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おたまじゃくし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧: to catch tadpoles
- おたまじゃくし⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{蛙|かえる}→蛙：04300_kaeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to grow from tadpole to frog
- ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おたまじゃくし: musical notes on a score (sense 2)

SENSE NOTE:
Sense 2 is informal/childlike, often used by people who can't read music or by music teachers speaking to children. It refers to the round notehead shape.
